posts.name: Chromium_Man
posts.cooked:
I am in love with SotM: the Video Game.  I really like that I am getting to familiarize myself more with the original heroes, villains, and environments.  I am abnormally excited for version 1.1 and the unlockable promo characters (I'm a sucker for unlockables).  I know that MigrantP said they were going to add statistic tracking to the game somewhere down the line, but there are a few things I would love to see:

1)  A damage tracker that tells you how much damage was dealt by each character at the end of the game.

2)  A graph that shows the changes in HP for each hero and the main villain at the end of the game.

I just finished a particularly epic game with Absolute Zero where he was down to less than 10 HP before I was able to get his modules in play and then his HP was bouncing up and down like a rubber ball.  At one point Fire in the Biosphere was in play along with Coolant Blast and I think he dealt about 35 damage over the course of two turns.

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Speaking of AZ, I'd like "AZ has dealt/been dealt X cold damage since Whenever" to be indicated somewhere. I've lost count of the number of times where I've, er, lost count of AZ's damage and accidentally killed him (and then been completely unable to rewind).

And when cards are discarded from the top of a deck, I'd like to know what they are. It can be important, and I can't always remember exactly what was in the trash before the discard.

Also, villain HP on the results screen would be really good too - I've been screencapping the end of every game, and it'd be good to see exactly how badly I got beaten when I look back at them.
